facts.text: I have seen "The Passion of the Christ."
I did not realize Monica Bellucci played Mary Magdalene in "The Passion of the Christ."
I might have to go back and watch "The Passion of the Christ" again.
I thought "Mary Magdalene" portrayed Mary Magdalene as a strong and independent woman rather than focusing on her past as a sinner.

events.text: Watched "The Passion of the Christ" and later learned Monica Bellucci played Mary Magdalene
